title: Integral intrinsic scalar associator commutes with normalized shifts
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D with characteristic p [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell$ different from p, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers, def-weil-algebraic-closure], and any scheme Y. Let $E\subseteq L\subseteq M$ be finite coefficient subfields of $\Omega$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set], with the prescribed small coefficient models and conjugated coefficient inclusions $i:E\to L$, $j:L\to M$, and $k:E\to M$ from [lem-route-coefficient-inclusion-laws], together with the equality $j\circ i=k$. Let $I_E$, $I_L$ and $I_M$ be the intrinsic derived-complete integral constructible categories [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], let $T_i,T_j,T_k$ be the prescribed completed integral scalar-extension functors [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], and let $a^I:T_j\circ T_i\xrightarrow{\sim}T_{j\circ i}$ be the prescribed integral scalar compositor (sfIntegralScalarComp) [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition], that is, the unique natural isomorphism whose image under the fully faithful inclusion $I_M$ is, at every $K$, the conjugate of the ordinary derived balanced-tensor associator of the completed coefficient rings by the three ordinary-to-completed comparisons sfIntegralOrdinaryComparison [def-zl-normalized-integral-scalar-comparison]; correct it along $j\circ i=k$ by the equality-transport isomorphism $T_{j\circ i}=T_k$. Equip $T_i,T_j,T_k$ with their ordinary-to-completed normalized coherent integer-shift comparisons [lem-route-integral-transition-comm-shift-exists-unique]. Then the corrected integral scalar compositor commutes with these integer shifts: $\operatorname{NatTrans.CommShift}((a^I\text{ followed by the equality-transport isomorphism}).hom)\,\mathbb Z$. The assertion includes identity inclusions and repeated fields.
